name: PROVENANCE VERIFIED
subtitle: Trust before you rely
description:
PROVENANCE VERIFIED™ by Veritan Inc lets trust clients look up provenance records for physical goods — gemstones, certificates, luxury items, and other high-value assets.

Scan the QR code on an item or enter a record ID manually. The app retrieves the server-issued trust determination: T1 through T4, or NOT QUALIFIED. Each tier reflects a different level of evidence and verification, clearly explained in the record.

For every record you can review:
• Claim verdicts — supported, asserted, contradicted, or revoked
• Evidence items and their integrity states
• Continuity and custody gaps
• Limitations and prohibited inferences

For qualified records, run a Reliance Assessment. Choose your purpose — Purchase, Resale, Insurance, or Public Marketing Claim — and the server returns a live actionability decision: ALLOW, ALLOW WITH QUALIFICATIONS, or DENY.

Save a Reliance Receipt that records the trust state, your purpose, and the decision at that moment. Receipts are stored on-device and flagged if the underlying record changes.

PROVENANCE VERIFIED™ displays what the server determines. The app does not guarantee value, ownership, legal title, or any insurance outcome.
release_notes: M3 release. Adds server-issued reliance receipts, actionability purpose selection, receipt staleness detection, and continuity gap display. Requires iOS 16 or later.
review_notes: To test without a live QR code: tap 'Enter ID manually' on the scanner screen and type a valid record ID. The app will fetch the trust record from the server and display the result. Network access is required — the app makes no local trust determinations. A test record ID can be provided on request.
